event_summary: Anti-PCC graffiti at Humboldt 7 on April20 followed by an officialist FEU ceremony; the anti-government act was graffiti, not a reported gathering; the FEU act was state-support, not protest against policy.
exclusion_reason: No public protest gathering is documented for the anti-PCC graffiti; no attendance is reported. The later officialist ceremony is not an anti-state protest and political rallies are excluded by the manual.

date.summary: 14ymedio dates the appearance of the sign to Thursday April20, 2023 (turn518003view0 lines43-45).

occurrence.summary: 14ymedio and DDC report the anti-PCC graffiti/sign, which is not a gathering. DDC says the subsequent FEU ceremony was an official political/commemorative act (turn430001view0 lines12-16); it is not an anti-government protest.

attendance.summary: DDC says decenas of students/workers attended the officialist commemoration (turn430001view0 line12), but this is not a protest against government and no exact count is given; attendance does not support an anti-state protest event.

notes: Twitter links cited by both articles were not opened. Distinguish the anti-PCC graffiti from the officialist ceremony; neither is coded as a qualifying anti-state gathering.
